title: Derby Heroines: Run, Bet, Win!
description:
Run. Bet. Win!

Derby Heroines brings the full grammar of horse racing to a track-and-field girls' racing game. Study the paddock, read the odds, buy your tickets — then take the starting gate yourself. Bet on yourself and cash in with your own two feet.

▍Races are action

Manage your dash gauge, grab skill orbs on the track, and unleash your once-per-race special move. Pack running, slipstreams, photo finishes — with a live tracking board and full race commentary in four languages.

▍A real betting system

Seven bet types — Win, Place, Quinella Place, Quinella, Exacta, Trio, Trifecta — plus wheel, box and formation betting. Odds are simulated per race, so favorites and long shots actually make sense. Every bet uses in-game currency only. No real money, ever.

▍PINZUDO 5

Pick the winner of five straight races (R7–R11) for a jackpot-style payout with carryover. Hit all five and get rich.

▍Collect & train

Recruit 100+ track girls via gacha — many with gloriously silly racehorse-style names. Check distance aptitude and running style, pick your entry, and level her up with race XP.

▍Supported languages

UI & commentary: Japanese / English / Traditional Chinese / French

▍Streaming & video policy

Streaming, videos and monetization are welcome without prior permission, for individuals and companies alike. No spoiler restrictions. Clips, thumbnails and screenshots are all fine. Perfect for "pick the winner with your chat" streams!
description_short: Horse-racing rules, track-girl speed. Buy Win, Exacta or Trifecta tickets against realistic odds — then hit the track and win the race yourself with dash, skills and specials. Collect 100+ runners, train them, chase the PINZUDO 5 jackpot. In-game currency only. Streaming welcome!
